info.title: BoxFleet hosted control plane (boxfleet.io)
info.description: Routes served by the boxfleet.io Worker. Default managed-connected deployments use JackAISaaS as the account, membership, subscription and billing authority. Product sessions must match the exact product, environment and organization. Managed features require explicit Hub entitlements and valid Hub quotas; neither local Stripe subscriptions nor local plan defaults can grant missing rights. Local issuer, plan mutations, membership mutations and Stripe billing routes are available only in explicitly selected autonomous modes; managed mode returns 409 account_authority_required with Hub account and portal URLs. Historical administrative reads are marked nonauthoritative. Job and organization records use PostgreSQL; missing storage answers 503. Hosted boxes need a configured provider. Hosted /v1/workspaces use tenant/product/environment ownership from current JackAISaaS product sessions, PostgreSQL lifecycle receipts and private source snapshots. Their finite lifetime is distinct from permanent VMs. Local CLI/MCP workspaces and synchronization remain separate workstation operations described in boxfleet.openapi.yaml. Removed simulation routes remain unavailable. tests/openapi-contract.test.mjs checks the complete route set in federated-autonomous mode; tests/account-authority.test.mjs checks managed refusals.

operationId.description: Stable close intention, null for legacy records without an intention.

quantity.description: Only non-null with full interval coverage.

knownQuantity.description: Observed quantity within covered intervals; not a billable total when coverage is incomplete.

state.description: Stored lifecycle observation, not a fresh provider probe.

storageGiB.description: Reserved allocated storage, not measured used-file bytes or a price.

reconciliationOperationId.description: Only on an uncertain item read after the current pending or uncertain lifecycle intention is verified in the same organization, product and environment. A read does not confirm dispatch or authorize reconciliation.

reserved.description: Latest runtime reservation on item reads. Null on collection summaries means details were not included; it does not mean zero reserved or consumed runtime. No measured usage or charge is reported.

budgetUntil.description: Budget window end, not provider expiry or proof the box stopped.

get.summary: Read recent hosted durable box records
get.description: Requires fresh JackAISaaS boxes.read authorization for this exact organization, product and deployment environment. No paid-feature entitlement is required for these reads. Returns recent stored records only, with no provider call, provisioning or billing. Configuration fingerprints, provider identifiers, receipts and access credentials are omitted. Runtime remains not-metered. HEAD and the /api alias have the same authorization.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum recent records; duplicates and other query parameters are rejected.

post.summary: Provision a durable box from a configured operator offer
post.description: Requires current JackAISaaS boxes.persistent.write authorization, org.boxes and org.persistent-boxes, and explicit bounded shared/durable allowances. The operator pins the provider, template and allocated storage. Runtime enforcement must be independently armed and recorded before allocation. An idempotency key is required in the header or body; if both are supplied they must match. A committed reservation dispatches create at most once; subsequent requests only observe it, including after server restart or a lost response. Minutes remain reserved and not-metered. No query parameters are accepted. Responses are private and not cacheable. The /api alias has the same contract. No production provider or runtime enforcer is configured by default.

200.description: Previously recorded running or closed allocation; replayed is true.

201.description: Provider allocation confirmed and recorded as running. Runtime remains reserved, not measured.

202.description: The reservation is held and the allocation remains unconfirmed. Repeated requests never dispatch create again; operator reconciliation is required.

400.description: Invalid body, unsupported fields, query parameters or idempotency key.

402.description: Missing durable entitlement, bounded allowance or available capacity.

403.description: Current authority denied the operation or target scope.

409.description: Idempotency conflict, unresolved prior budget or UTC month boundary.

503.description: Authority, storage, operator offer or independent runtime enforcement unavailable. Missing configuration is refused before reservation.

get.summary: Read one hosted durable box record and its latest runtime reservation
get.description: Requires fresh JackAISaaS boxes.read authorization and exact organization/product/environment ownership. Reads remain available after a paid-feature downgrade. The result is a stored observation with a reserved runtime budget, not measured consumption or provider availability. An uncertain item may include reconciliationOperationId after an exact scoped lifecycle-intention lookup, allowing recovery if the prior mutation response was lost; the collection never includes it. The handle does not confirm dispatch or remove the mutation fence, and POST reconcile still requires boxes.close. No credentials, configuration fingerprints, provider identifiers or deletion receipts are exposed. No query parameters or mutations are accepted.

200.description: Private stored record and reserved budget; runtime status is not-metered.

get.summary: Read scoped provider usage evidence for one hosted durable box
get.description: Requires fresh JackAISaaS boxes.read authority and exact organization/product/environment ownership. from and to are canonical UTC instants, at most 31 days apart and not in the future. The two meters distinguish measured runtime from retained allocated storage. Partial or unknown coverage has null quantity and knownQuantity is only an observed subtotal. No provider receipt, price, billing event or reservation release is exposed. GET and HEAD are private and not cacheable; the /api alias has the same contract.

200.description: Private provider evidence summary with explicit interval coverage.

post.summary: Start a retained hosted box
post.description: Requires fresh JackAISaaS boxes.persistent.write authority and positive durable/shared quotas. A confirmed stop is required. Reserves additional monthly runtime and arms independent enforcement before starting the pinned allocation. Retained storage stays reserved. No query parameters are accepted. Mutations commit an intention before dispatch and dispatch at most once. Lost or late results remain unconfirmed. Responses contain stored observations and reserved, not measured, runtime. An idempotency key is required in the header or body; both must match when supplied together.

202.description: Operation remains unconfirmed; reconcile its operation ID without repeating the mutation.

post.summary: Stop a retained hosted box
post.description: Requires fresh boxes.close authority, including after a paid-feature downgrade. Stops the pinned allocation while retaining its disk, box count and existing runtime reservations. No query parameters are accepted. Mutations commit an intention before dispatch and dispatch at most once. Lost or late results remain unconfirmed. Responses contain stored observations and reserved, not measured, runtime. An idempotency key is required in the header or body; both must match when supplied together.

Only matching ownership, storage and target state can resolve uncertainty. No query parameters are accepted. Mutations commit an intention before dispatch and dispatch at most once. Lost or late results remain unconfirmed. Responses contain stored observations and reserved, not measured, runtime.

post.summary: Close a hosted durable box through its pinned operator provider
post.description: Requires fresh JackAISaaS boxes.close authorization with boxfleet:boxes:write and exact organization/product/environment ownership. Cleanup remains available after a paid-feature downgrade. No body or query parameters are accepted. A serialized durable intention admits at most one provider deletion. Only a matching positive acknowledgement releases retained count and storage; runtime remains reserved and not-metered. Responses are private and not cacheable. The /api alias has the same authorization. An operator must configure the trusted provider adapter; this endpoint does not provision or activate providers.

200.description: Closure is recorded; repeat requests return the same result without deleting again.

202.description: Closure is unconfirmed. Lost, late, negative or mismatched acknowledgements and failed receipt persistence retain reservations. Repeat requests never dispatch another deletion; operator reconciliation is required.

400.description: Invalid UUID, body or query parameters.

403.description: Current authority denied cleanup or the organization/product/environment differs.

404.description: No durable box in this exact target scope.

409.description: Unconfirmed or changed provider allocation requires operator reconciliation.

503.description: Authority or storage unavailable, or no matching operator provider adapter. Missing configuration refuses before any close intention or deletion.

post.summary: Create a hosted box
post.description: Requires a JackAISaaS product session for this organization. Answers 503 until production storage is configured. The box is created by the configured provider (E2B) and counts against the plan's concurrent-box limit, checked by the database (402 quota_exceeded). Without a provider: 503 provider_unavailable and nothing is recorded. The response carries the provider access token once; it is never stored. In managed-connected mode org.boxes must be explicitly true and concurrentBoxes must be supplied by the Hub as a nonnegative integer or -1. Missing or malformed quotas answer 402 quota_unavailable before provider creation.
